Class_Skill_Desc_Invulnerability: Prevents attacks from reducing a target party member's HP to less than 1.</br>Duration: 8s
Class_Skill_Desc_Phantom Doom: Chance to afflict target with Phantom Doom.</br>Duration: 8 to 60s</br>Target is incapacitated when effect expires.</br>Shares a recast timer with Recuperation.</br>Has no effect on targets outside of combat.</br>Effect ends upon target leaving combat.
Class_Skill_Desc_Phantom Rejuvenation: Grants Phantom Rejuvenation to self or target party member.</br>Phantom Rejuvenation Effect: Restores HP of target and nearby party members within 30 yalms when effect expires</br>Cure Potency: 90,000</br>Duration: 20s
Class_Skill_Desc_Predict: Grants Prediction of Judgment, Prediction of Cleansing, Prediction of Blessing, or Prediction of Starfall, allowing the execution of an action depending on the prophecy granted.</br>Phantom Judgment Action Effect: Deals unaspected damage to nearby enemies while healing self and nearby party members</br>Cleansing Action Effect: Deals unaspected damage to nearby enemies and freezes time</br>Blessing Action Effect: Heals self and nearby party members, as well as granting Regen</br>Starfall Action Effect: Deals unaspected damage to self and nearby enemies</br>When the effect of a prediction expires, a new prophecy is granted. If all predictions expire without a commensurate action being used, the prophecy changes to False Prediction, causing damage over time to self with a potency of 50,000.</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Skill_Desc_Recuperation: Grants Recuperation to self or target party member.</br>Duration: 20s</br>When effect expires, removes a single detrimental effect from target and all nearby party members.</br>Recuperation changes to Fortified Recuperation if effect is not triggered.</br>Fortified Recuperation Effect: Removes a detrimental effect from target and nearby party members if afflicted with a detrimental effect</br>Duration: 3s</br>Shares a recast timer with Phantom Doom.
